wps.notes: The pilot WP is folded in here: the pilot's pinned baseline (flow-savings-pilot-bill-12), the calendar draw (security-roles-06) and the tier rule (pages-D-11) all change verify.py, so one worktree owns verify.py, the pilot routes and the pilot pages. Expose the new fields in the API for stage 2 (per day and in the summary: claimed vs all-days totals, withheld reason, which levers a withheld day keeps, the MDI lever's month, provisional flag and rate version, carry-over share, fee basis) and list them in API_CONTRACT/types. Claims: only days whose control was actually in force claim (paused, released, failed plan, offline edge, native block do not). MDI lever priced per month with that month's tariff version, claimed once per billing month and pro rata for a sub-range, never from withheld days, provisional until the month closes; the month is re-scored at its end or after late data from inside verify.compute_day, which the nightly job already calls (scheduler.py is control-edge's: no edit there). Carry-over: chain only through claiming periods, credit native blocks' hand-over too, address HANDOFF 8.A.1 (done when the per-day ledger tracks the continuous replay within about Rs 1k over 11 days for several seeds); re-scoring that changes closed months is limited/flagged with an audit line; legacy (pre-round-6) rows flagged. Switchback result: Preliminary until the minimum days per arm, counterfactual agreement check (15 %/Rs 300), and no switchback result at a monitor-tier site (its days are recommendation_only). Tuned baseline gets the HOMER cycle-charging rule at genset sites; the perfect-foresight bound includes unserved and MDI terms and refuses time-limited solves. The metering factor (engine-savings-09) and the per-connection ledger are stage 2's. Pilot: PUT /pilot gets a request model (schemas.py) with sign-off and amendments server-owned; a second POST /pilot/start is refused; the native capture version is pinned at start and verify replays the pinned version; a later capture is recorded as an amendment (reason, old and new values, audit row). The 'a typed capture cannot claim read back by the edge device' half of flow-savings-pilot-bill-12 is sites-onboarding's (native capture form and validation). Start gates: control tier at least advisory for switchback, baseline window present with a data-completeness check and KPI list (tab A), calendar not in the past, rule checks incl. holiday closures (tab C) must pass, and the tab shows red when they fail. Calendar: a server-side draw from os entropy (secrets) stored with the calendar, not re-rollable or backdatable once locked, and only blocks painted before they began count toward the 8 weeks; 3-day blocks only where allowed, the right word for pairs, correct month labels (Nov 2026), page refreshes after 409 calendar_locked; .ics escapes text (no CRLF injection), has DTSTAMP and a file name. The Savings-page halves (amendments shown on Savings, the monitor-tier ledger title, the switchback panel) are stage 2's (features/savings); pilot success-criteria scoring (pages-D-12) is stage 2's. Every money change gets a golden test. batches.theme: Grid-up load shedding, peak-window buying and reason labels
SoC floors, inverter limits and the outage reserve

Genset and off-grid dispatch

wps.notes: No load shedding with the grid up (U = L on grid-up steps) and the guard catches it (the guard is control-edge's: cover it with a test against your problem); no grid buying inside the peak window to refill the reserve unless priced and labelled as such; reasons derived from the numbers (no 'likely outage' at 1-3 %, no 'cheaper' in the peak, no 'Wear > saving' next to a peak discharge); grid charging smoothed under the plan's own MDI cap. Plan SoC floor = the higher of BMS soc_min and the floor the delivered table/fallback holds (agree the value with delivery-twin's compile; the compile call is in tick, yours). Inverter limits: PV to AC plus battery discharge within the inverter's kW AC (the engine half of flow-onboarding-09, whose form and server check are sites-onboarding's) and the reserve limited by battery discharge and inverter AC power; an AMF auto-start covers the reserve instead of a 30-minute full-load battery reserve; the 'reserve floor when an outage is likely' setting is honoured; no double-charged shortfall. Battery: a start below soc_min stays feasible, out-of-band relaxation only for the start, stale SoC widens sigma, sigma re-anchors at a full charge (fixes the 95 % for 48 h plans; prove the Faisalabad/Lahore plans no longer cost more than native), BMS trust score low without an independent estimate, temperature derating with the derate/imbalance/capacity_drop alerts raised by battery.state (alerts.evaluate already reads them: no alerts.py edit), cycle cap applied. MDI: month-start anchoring fixed, 'MDI rise' and the cost breakdown itemise M2 instead of 'Not itemised', c_cal_hold as holding cost to the next peak, month_to_date treats missing minutes as unknown. Genset/off-grid: fuel carried between ticks (tank 0 = unknown, not unlimited), follow cap on every grid-down step whatever gen_charge_allowed, no simultaneous charge/discharge, no curtailing free PV while the battery has room, genset marginal cost in the grid-tied terminal value; genset charging (GEN_CHARGE_SUPPORTED, engine-plans-live-18) and the Punjab duty by province (engine-tariffs-09) are stage 2's. Time limits: tick is yours whole; a time-limited incumbent with a large gap does not supersede the last plan and the relaxed retry is labelled; surface time_limited_recent on the plan answer/page (the deterministic work limit / idle re-solve of HANDOFF 8.A.3 stays out). Plan page: Flags/override column and past-24-hour actuals in the table view, legible past slots, reason chips not one tab stop each and readable on a phone, re-solve feedback with the guard's reason and no raw solver text, an all-day slot written as 'all day' in slots-view.tsx (slot-words.ts is delivery-twin's). Golden tests for every cost term changed. Critic corrections to the draft: (1) the pilot WP is folded into savings-engine, because its pinned baseline, calendar draw and tier rule all edit verify.py; (2) one owner per file in stage 1 (only function splits remain, each written in owns_files): control_state -> control-edge (with role-owner-08, so demo-seed and fleet-overview no longer edit it), plans.tick -> optimiser-plans whole (control-edge acts through control_release and its own functions), scheduler.py -> control-edge alone (the month-end re-score runs inside verify.compute_day), verify.py's bill functions -> tariffs, slot-words.ts -> delivery-twin, battery-cards.tsx -> auth-security alone, api.py -> auth-security, devices-page.tsx -> telemetry, the key-folder backup -> founder-console, alerts.py -> alerts-reports alone (battery alerts already come from battery.state; the tariff-staleness rule brief-vs-build-18 moved to alerts-reports), flow-onboarding-09 -> sites-onboarding (its engine half named in optimiser-plans), role-operator-07 -> sites-onboarding (owns the routes it gates); (3) findings that need several stage-1 WPs' code moved to the stage-2 batch 1: multi-connection with the metering factor (engine-savings-09) and the Punjab duty by connection (engine-tariffs-09), Mode B in the twin/guard/demo (engine-delivery-17), genset charging (engine-plans-live-18), event re-solves (brief-vs-build-15); app-wide row-action names (frontend-a11y-17) and written dates (role-operator-28) moved to the stage-2 sweep; (4) duplicates: flow-telemetry-plan-control-23 is no longer a duplicate of frontend-states-formats-15 (control_state's chip label vs the Overview/Fleet next-event times, different code and owners); (5) deferrals: role-analyst-16 is no longer deferred, because the existing raw-JSON draft dialog has its own defects (parser message twice, raw kind names, no example body), so it goes to tariffs; (6) batches regrouped to 4-7 findings and ordered by severity, counting each canonical id's duplicates. Stage 1 (15 WPs, in parallel): savings-engine, tariffs, delivery-twin, control-edge, optimiser-plans, forecasts-outages, telemetry-genset-battery, sites-onboarding, fleet-overview, alerts-reports, auth-security, founder-console, shell-nav, ui-charts-a11y, demo-seed. Stage 2 (on the integrated stage-1 branch): savings-ui-crosscut (cross-module engine batch, Savings page, pilot go/no-go, audit walk, cross-page sweeps) and tests-ci (engine acceptance tests, browser check). Stage 3: parity-ui (Boxlytics look) and docs. Remaining function splits: plans.py (optimiser-plans / control-edge), delivery.py (delivery-twin compile half / control-edge keys and messages), routes_sites.py (sites-onboarding / fleet-overview / control-edge control_state), routes_telemetry.py (telemetry / forecasts-outages outage routes / auth-security events), routes_savings.py (savings-engine pilot and switchback / tariffs bills / alerts-reports fleet_savings flag), verify.py (savings-engine / tariffs bill functions), routes_plans.py (control-edge / delivery-twin plan_compare), twin.py (delivery-twin / demo-seed truth), routes_founder.py and store_founder.py (founder-console / auth-security set-password), auth.py (auth-security / sites-onboarding's one appended 'manage_sites' entry). Some findings are split by agreement and named in both WPs' notes: pages-A-03 (header line, shell-nav), pages-D-16 (Tariffs-page state, tariffs), flow-savings-pilot-bill-12, frontend-states-formats-11 and engine-forecast-05 (form halves, sites-onboarding). Shared additive: types/api.ts, lib/api/endpoints.ts, lib/api/keys.ts, API_CONTRACT.md, BACKEND_ASKS.md, lib/format.ts, lib/time.ts, schemas.py, new test fixtures; store.py migrations are renumbered at integration. Parts of findings that restate planned work stay out and are named in the notes: report schedules (pages-D-25, role-analyst-32), alert sending (pages-D-29), the twin-priced 2-slot ranking (engine-delivery-04), the deterministic work limit / idle re-solve (engine-optimiser-08, engine-plans-live-19), CI/deployment (tests-ci). Accounts stay preassigned (no Google, no self-signup).
